name: warmarket
description: Real-time multiplayer nation + stock market strategy game

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c magenta,cyan,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
